map.家庭自测血压如何取值？: How to measure BP at home?
map.静息 5 分钟后、坐姿上臂式血压计、间隔 1–2 分钟测 2–3 次取均值；避开: After 5 min rest, seated upper-arm cuff, 2-3 readings 1-2 min apart averaged; avoid caffeine/exercise. Home standard usually <135/85 as goal; diagnosis by standardized measurement.
map.血压降到多少算理想？: How low should BP go ideally?
map.一般成人 <140/90；合并糖尿病、慢性肾病或心衰多目标 <130/80（具体: Generally adults <140/90; with diabetes, CKD or heart failure often <130/80 (per guideline/tolerance). Lower smoothly, avoid too fast/low causing dizziness/hypoperfusion; elderly especially gradual.
map.只靠饮食运动能控制吗？: Can diet and exercise alone control it?
map.低危且轻度升高者可先 3–6 个月生活方式干预（减盐、减重、运动、限酒）；若未达: Low-risk and mildly elevated can first try 3-6 months lifestyle (less salt, weight loss, exercise, limit alcohol); if not met or medium-high risk, start drug combo early; reaching target is key to lower stroke/MI risk.

map.分级（JNC-7，取收缩压/舒张压较高级）：SBP≥160 或 DBP≥100→: Grading (JNC-7, take the higher of SBP/DBP): SBP >=160 or DBP >=100 -> grade 2 hypertension; SBP >=140 or DBP >=90 -> grade 1; SBP >=120 or DBP >=80 -> prehypertension; otherwise normal (<120/80). Risk (JNC-7): normal/pre with no risk factors -> low; normal/pre with 1-2 risk factors or grade 1/2 with none -> medium; normal/pre with clinical conditions or grade 1 with 1-2 risk factors -> high; grade 1 with target-organ damage/clinical conditions, or grade 2 with any risk factor -> very high.
